title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): choose from multiple voice styles in voice chats
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap details and documented voice-chat behaviour agree with the sources checked. Independent searches found no voice-style-specific admin control, licensing rule or meter; the page appropriately leaves those details and the rollout default open.
